children.dataScript: (function() { var items = []; var count = DataManager.maxSavefiles(); for (var i = 1; i <= count; i++) { var info = DataManager.loadSavefileInfo(i); var valid = DataManager.isThisGameFile(i); var chars = []; if (valid && info && info.characters) { for (var j = 0; j < Math.min(info.characters.length, 4); j++) { var c = info.characters[j]; chars.push([c[0], c[1], 220 + j * 48, 100]); } } items.push({ name: TextManager.file + ' ' + i, symbol: i, enabled: true, subText: (info && info.title) ? info.title : '', rightText: (info && info.playtime) ? info.playtime : '', characters: chars }); } return items; })()

children.dataScript: (function(){ var goods=$ctx.shopGoods||[]; var money=$gameParty.gold(); var items=[]; var itemData=[]; goods.forEach(function(g){ var item=g[0]===0?$dataItems[g[1]]:g[0]===1?$dataWeapons[g[1]]:$dataArmors[g[1]]; if(item){ var price=g[2]===0?item.price:g[3]; items.push({name:item.name, symbol:'buy', iconIndex:item.iconIndex, enabled:price<=money&&!$gameParty.hasMaxItems(item), numberText:String(price)}); itemData.push({item:item, price:price}); } }); $ctx.buyItems=itemData; return items; })()

onCursor.code: var win=this._widgetMap['buy_list']._window; var idx=win.index(); var data=$ctx.buyItems; if(data&&idx>=0&&data[idx]){ var info=data[idx]; $ctx.helpText=info.item.description; $ctx.selectedItem=info.item; $ctx.selectedPrice=info.price; $ctx.statusText=info.item.name+'\n\\C[16]가격:\\C[0] '+info.price+' '+(typeof TextManager!=='undefined'?TextManager.currencyUnit:'G'); }else{ $ctx.helpText=''; $ctx.selectedItem=null; $ctx.statusText=''; }

ok.code: var idx=this._widgetMap['buy_list']._window.index(); var info=$ctx.buyItems&&$ctx.buyItems[idx]; if(info){ $ctx.selectedItem=info.item; $ctx.selectedPrice=info.price; var maxBuy=Math.min($gameParty.maxItems(info.item)-$gameParty.numItems(info.item), info.price>0?Math.floor($gameParty.gold()/info.price):99); maxBuy=Math.max(1,maxBuy); var nw=this._widgetMap['number_win']; nw.setup(info.item,maxBuy,info.price); nw._window.visible=true; this._widgetMap['buy_list']._window.visible=false; this._navManager.focusWidget('number_win'); }

children.dataScript: (function(){ var cat=$ctx.sellCategory||'all'; var all=$gameParty.allItems(); var filtered=all.filter(function(item){ if(!item||item.price<=0)return false; if(cat==='item')return DataManager.isItem(item)&&item.itypeId===1; if(cat==='weapon')return DataManager.isWeapon(item); if(cat==='armor')return DataManager.isArmor(item); if(cat==='keyItem')return DataManager.isItem(item)&&item.itypeId===2; return true; }); $ctx.sellItems=filtered; return filtered.map(function(item){ return {name:item.name, symbol:'sell', iconIndex:item.iconIndex, enabled:true, numberText:String($gameParty.numItems(item))}; }); })()

onCursor.code: var win=this._widgetMap['sell_list']._window; var idx=win.index(); var items=$ctx.sellItems; if(items&&idx>=0&&items[idx]){ var item=items[idx]; var sellPrice=Math.floor(item.price/2); $ctx.helpText=item.description; $ctx.selectedItem=item; $ctx.selectedPrice=sellPrice; $ctx.statusText=item.name+'\n\\C[16]판매가:\\C[0] '+sellPrice+' '+(typeof TextManager!=='undefined'?TextManager.currencyUnit:'G'); }else{ $ctx.helpText=''; $ctx.selectedItem=null; $ctx.statusText=''; $ctx.selectedPrice=0; }
